label: VERIFIED
extraction: Unified Memory MCP server setup. stdio server optional, not enabled by ECC default .mcp.json. After installing ECC, copy ecc-memory-vault entry from mcp-configs/mcp-servers.json into each harness. Replace placeholder with lowercase server identity. Server command: ECC_MEMORY_HARNESS=codex ecc-memory-mcp. MCP process binds writes and target filtering to ECC_MEMORY_HARNESS; tool callers cannot claim another source identity or override target filter. user scope remains disabled unless ECC_MEMORY_ALLOW_USER_SCOPE=1 and tool call explicitly requests that scope. Exposes only: memory_save, memory_search, memory_read, memory_doctor. MCP surface deliberately has no review, promotion, overwrite, transcript import, or shell-execution tool. Runtime prerequisite: npm install -g ecc-universal required for CLI and MCP.
